title: DEF CON 23 - Marc Rogers and Kevin Mahaffey - How to Hack a Tesla Model S
summary: A DEF CON 23 talk by Marc Rogers and Kevin Mahaffey walking through the architecture of the Tesla Model S, what Tesla got right and wrong, and how the interconnected systems can be hacked. It also covers the data the car collects.
why: HN cites it as a detailed technical reference on Tesla's security design, especially the firewalling of infotainment from the CAN bus.
